purpose: Actual Chrome public spectator and separate private preview/terminal capture regression fixtures; not training samples or acceptance certificates.

captureContext.clientAttribution: Manual capture-session UI observation: default legacy OU at 16:47 UTC; actual /beta/ Preact entry at 16:49, then UU and OU spectator rooms; root reload around 16:52:15 returned to default legacy UU. Client labels come from this UI observation, not URL inference or trace payloads.
captureContext.routeCaveat: Preact rewrites the route to root; route alone does not identify the client. SPA room changes changed captureSession; retain those session boundaries.
captureContext.history: Recorders used isolated temporary history; producer and tests do not access any history.

sanitization: Player names, rooms, capture/session UUIDs and all mon identifiers are aliased consistently. Removed free-text/chat/join/leave/timer/timestamp/rating/avatar lines or fields; blank lines preserve original source indexes. Protocol mechanics and supplemental sso-state values otherwise unchanged. Capture receipt UTC times retained only in provenance.

coverage.statusCure: Absent from frozen traces; test observed toxic/burn preservation only, not cure/non-resurrection after cure.
coverage.recovery: Lower authority. sso-state p1 hints, stale conditions and 1000/1000 placeholders are captured claims, not private HP or own-side truth.
coverage.omissions: Selected observations only: repeated recovery, nonmechanical frames and unrelated requests/responses omitted. Original sequence gaps and partial turns retained. Second trace is a fixed complete-row prefix and may continue appending.

cases.coverage: Actual protocol backlog trimmed after turn 12 for common-prefix comparison; original frame reached turn 22.

Original preview belongs to a different session. New session starts without roster; later recovery contains its missing prefix and matching protocol suffix. Recovered roster remains recovery authority; do not join sessions.
Explicit cold replay starting from a real recovery, omitting its earlier same-session protocol; recovered roster/turn 1 remains recovery, subsequent turns 2/3 remain protocol.
Protocol backlog through turn 9, selected subsequent public protocol through turn 16, then matching recovery across the recorder rotation.

comparisonScope: Trim both comparison inputs at the declared canonical turn boundary; compare public facts and roster only, ignoring transport metadata and retaining original authority separately. No whole-frame or private BattleSnapshot parity claim.
